verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents a knowledge layer for its Customer Agent. That knowledge is built from your own resolved tickets and connected sources, and you can view it with version history, so answers are plausibly grounded in your own content. Nothing in the evidence shows answers being restricted to that content, and nothing shows answers citing which article or source they drew from. Missing for 10: per-answer source or article attribution, an explicit guarantee that answers are grounded only in your knowledge, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every answer is grounded in my own content and shows which article or source it drew from

citations.quote: researches everything you've connected to set up baseline Customer Agent configurations: memory, knowledge, and base tools
See your live knowledge and its version history - who published what and when, with a diff for every change
Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.
